notes.title: Talents Digital Behind-the-scenes Book Release! 🎉
notes.notes:
[p align="start"]Hi everyone!
[p align="start"]Exciting news—our Talents: Behind-the-Scenes Digital Book is finally out on Steam! 🎉
[p align="start"]This digital art/dev book is over 130 pages, packed with:

Concept art and scrapped designs

Art, UI, and graphic design processes

CG Gallery w/ commentary

Writing and research processes

Game design insights

Voice acting process 

Character profiles and relationship map

Compatibility quiz

Full walkthrough

Artists interviews

Dev postmortem

Exhibit diaries

Secrets from production that never saw the light

…and more!
[p align="start"]We really wanted this book to feel like opening up our dev journals and letting you peek inside—the chaos, the lessons, and the love that went into making this otome. Do note that it's full of spoilers, so read at your own risk!
[p align="start"]🎉 To celebrate launch week, it’s 10% OFF now on Steam!
[p align="start"]Get it here: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3966840/Talents_Digital_Behindthescenes_book/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you all so much for the support—it means the world that you’d want to see what happens behind the pixels. 💖

notes.title: Talents Demo Version 4 Update
notes.notes:
We’ve updated the Talents prologue demo!
This is the closest version yet to the full game.

What’s new?

Revised character motivations and writing to align with the full game

Skip function added for Writing Skill Event QTE

UI updates (Major changes to the Gallery feature, Choice menus, Phone texts, Writing Skill Event QTE, Main Menu, etc.)

Content warnings added

New voice acting settings

New Dictionary feature to review previously unlocked words

Option to reset game data

Bug fixes

Proofreading fixes

Minor art revisions

We’re getting closer to launch, and we can’t wait for you to meet your cofounders in the full game! Thanks for your continued support. We hope you enjoy the update! 💕

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
🎉 After more than two years in development… it’s finally here. 🎉

TALENTS launches on July 14, 2025 (PH timezone) on Itch and Steam!

This project has been a labor of love, and we're so excited (and nervous) to finally share it with you all.  Get ready to meet your handsome cofounders, survive relationship drama, and navigate romance in a startup workplace—all while diving into the wild world of indie game dev. 🎮💖

Thank you so much to everyone who’s followed the project, shared kind words, or even just wishlisted it.


Mark your calendars—launch day’s just around the corner! 📅
